scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Welcome to Prontera,
the beautiful capital of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. If
you have questions or need help finding something in the city, don't hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
欢迎来到普隆德拉，卢恩·米德加兹王国美丽的首都。
如果有问题，或是需要城内的路线指引，请尽管问我。

scripts.text: City Guide.
scripts.translation: 城市导览

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Notice
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
需要我在您的小地图上标记地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Swordman Association,
which handles Job Changes
to the Swordman class, has
moved to Izlude. This facility
is just an empty building now.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
负责办理剑士转职手续的剑士协会已经搬到依斯鲁得了。
这里如今只剩下一栋空楼。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Sanctuary
handles Job Changes to
the Acolyte class, and can
be found in the northeast
corner of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
普隆德拉圣堂位于普隆德拉的东北角，负责办理服事的转职手续。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Chivralry,
which is responsible for
the safety of our capital, is
in Prontera's northwest corner.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
负责守护首都安全的普隆德拉骑士团位于普隆德拉的西北角。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Weapon Shop
is located northeast
of the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
武器店位于中央喷泉的东北方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Tool Shop
is located northwest
of the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
道具店位于中央喷泉的西北方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Inns in Prontera are
located both to the east
and west of Prontera's
central fountain area.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
普隆德拉的旅馆分别位于中央喷泉区域的东侧和西侧。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Trading Post
can be found southeast
from the central fountain.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
交易所位于中央喷泉的东南方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Pub is located
southeast of the fountain,
behind the Trading Post.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
酒馆位于喷泉的东南方，就在交易所后面。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
If you head north from
the central fountain, you'll
find an empty area in which
both branches of the Prontera
Library can be accessed if you
head towards the east or west.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
从中央喷泉往北走，您会看到一片空地。
再往东或往西走，就能分别找到普隆德拉图书馆的两个分馆。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Job Agency is
just southwest of the
central fountain area.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
职业介绍所位于中央喷泉区域的西南方。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The Prontera Castle is
located at the northern
sector of this city. You can
go to the fields that are north
of Prontera by going through
the castle's rear exit.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
普隆德拉王宫位于城市北部。
穿过王宫的后门，就能前往普隆德拉北边的野外。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
The City Hall
is located in the
southwest corner
in our city of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
市政厅位于普隆德拉城的西南角。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Prontera Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
请从以下菜单中选择一个地点。
[普隆德拉向导]
如果不想让小地图继续显示地点标记，请选择“移除小地图标记”。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
魔法与科技的进步让我们得以更新信息系统，现在可以在您的小地图上标记地点，方便您辨认方向。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
小地图位于屏幕右上角。
如果看不到，请按Ctrl + Tab，或点击基本信息窗口中的“地图”按钮。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
点击小地图上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或缩小地图。
祝您在普隆德拉游历愉快。

scripts.text:
[Prontera Guide]
Well, adventurer...
I hope your journeys
through Rune-Midgarts
are both fun and safe.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉向导]
好了，冒险者...
愿您在卢恩·米德加兹的旅程既愉快，又平安。
